tools.name: departi_check_visa
tools.title: Check Visa Requirements
tools.description: Check visa requirements for any nationality/destination pair. Returns visa type, maximum stay duration, required documents, and digital nomad visa availability. Covers 406 origin countries across 42 European destinations.

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the traveler's nationality (e.g., 'US', 'GB', 'DE')

destination.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the destination (e.g., 'PT', 'BG', 'HR')

tools.name: departi_check_tax
tools.title: Check Tax Implications
tools.description: Analyze tax residency implications for a given country. Returns income tax rates, treaty applicability, social security obligations, FEIE eligibility (US citizens), and filing requirements. Covers 49 countries with full fiscal profiles.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to check tax implications for

income_usd.description: Annual income in USD for rate calculations

tools.name: departi_track_schengen
tools.title: Track Schengen Days
tools.description: Calculate 90/180-day Schengen zone usage for non-Schengen nationals. Returns days used, days remaining, overstay risk level, next safe entry date, and rolling window projections. Uses authenticated user's travel history when available.

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the traveler

entries.description: Travel history entries (optional if authenticated — uses profile data)

tools.name: departi_search_accommodation
tools.title: Search Accommodation
tools.description: Search curated accommodation with pricing across 189 European destinations. Returns persona-matched results (budget, mid-range, premium) with availability, pricing, and booking links.

tools.name: departi_search_transport
tools.title: Search Transport
tools.description: Search flights, trains, and buses with pricing, travel time, and carrier details. Multi-modal results for complete route planning across Europe.

origin.description: Departure city or IATA airport code

destination.description: Arrival city or IATA airport code

tools.name: departi_search_experiences
tools.title: Search Experiences
tools.description: Search tours, activities, and local experiences matched to traveler personality. Curated beyond tourist traps — local food tours, cultural workshops, outdoor adventures, and more.

tools.name: departi_get_profile
tools.title: Get Travel Profile
tools.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's travel profile — nationality, tax residence, traveler type, travel history, and preferences. Powers personalized responses across all other tools. Requires OAuth authentication.
